originality.rationale: The closest primary source, arXiv:2609.14463v1, explicitly leaves moduli outside its positive and negative families unresolved; \(q=9\) is the smallest such modulus. Its proof for positive cases assumes rational independence of positive eigenvalues, which fails at \(q=9\). The new statement instead exploits the complete one-relation lattice and a phase curve lying inside the resulting subtorus. Baptista–Coutinho–Marques provides the framework and small path examples but not \(P_8\). Exact-claim, parameter, alias, and implication searches returned no covering published-record index record or public source. Residual historical-alias risk remains and is stated separately.
residual_risks: An equivalent \(P_8\) construction could exist in older continuous-time quantum-walk literature under terminology not surfaced by the targeted searches; no such source was found.
The result does not settle other dependent-spectrum moduli, so it should not be read as a general extension of the 2026 positive classification.
